info.name: CRM Full API
info.description: DemoCRM backend . Use variables: {{base_url}} (default http://127.0.0.1:8000/api) aur {{access_token}} (login se copy karein).

request.description: Public - koi auth nahi. User automatically Employee role me banta hai.
Public. Response  access_token + refresh_token . access_token ko {access_token} variable me daalein.
Public. Naya access_token milta hai.
Sab active users ki list - assignment dropdown ke liye. user_id (UUID) wahan se copy karein.
Dusre user ka profile dekhne ke liye Admin/Manager hona chahiye.
Public. Email pe 6-digit OTP jata hai (console/email backend ke hisaab se).
Admin/Manager hi dekh sakta hai.
permissions = permission ID list (optional). rolename max 13 chars.
Admin role update nahi hota.
Permission IDs role pe add karta hai. IDs /permissions/ se lo.
Admin/Manager/Employee default roles delete nahi hote.
status/priority/category = master data se integer ID.
manager = Manager role wale user ka UUID.
Sirf REJECTED meeting, sirf creator reschedule kar sakta hai.
Filters: ?reminder_status=&reminder_type=&task=&meeting=&is_sent=&search=
task_id ya meeting_id - ek dena zaroori.
Filters: ?followup_status=&followup_type=&task_id=&created_by=&search= - Employee sirf apne assigned tasks ke followups dekhta hai.
Employee sirf apne assigned task ke liye bana sakta hai.
PATCH body: {"description":"Updated"}. DELETE: koi body nahi.
PATCH body: {"display_order":2} etc.
current_stage usi pipeline ka hona chahiye. status khud ACTIVE set hota hai.
LOST/CONVERTED lead direct update nahi hota - workflow endpoints use karo.
stage_id = PipelineStage ka UUID.
empty body - lost lead waapas active.
Default lead se aa jate hain; email + phone required.
query, email, phone, gst_number, company_name - sab optional filters.
lead ya customer - ek hi dena hai. follow_up_required=true pe follow_up_date chahiye.
lead CONVERTED hona chahiye.
?lead=<uuid> optional filter.
empty body - approval me jata hai (PENDING_APPROVAL).
empty body.
empty body - SENT mark karta hai.
empty body - customer auto-create hota hai.
rejection_reason required.
version optional. DRAFT/PENDING_APPROVAL state me PDF nahi milega.
event_type aur is_active optional filters.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Task Assigned Alert",
  "event_type": "TASK_ASSIGNED",
  "message": "Task {task_title} assigned by {employee_name}",
  "channel": "IN_APP",
  "is_default": true,
  "is_active": true
}

request.description: event_type: NotificationEventType me se (TASK_ASSIGNED, LEAD_CREATED, MEETING_CREATED, FOLLOWUP_CREATED, QUOTATION_SUBMITTED, ROLE_CHANGED, MANUAL, etc). channel: IN_APP / EMAIL / BOTH.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Task Assigned Alert v2",
  "event_type": "TASK_ASSIGNED",
  "message": "Task {task_title} assigned by {employee_name}",
  "channel": "BOTH",
  "is_default": true,
  "is_active": true
}

request.description: PATCH bhi chalta hai (partial).
Soft delete - is_active=false ho jata hai.
recipient_id ya recipient_ids (array) - ek chahiye. template_id optional; custom_message optional.
is_read optional filter.
empty body. PATCH bhi chalta hai.
initial_fields optional. Template + pehli version ek saath banti hai.
from_version_id optional - na do to blank version banega.
PUT edit karne ke liye. Is locked (submissions ho gayi) to edit nahi hoga.
field_key: lowercase + underscore. field_type: text/textarea/number/boolean/date/time/select (select pe options chahiye).
Locked version ke fields edit/delete nahi hote.
Saare fields apne display_order ke saath bhejo.

body.raw:
{
  "stage": "{{stage_id}}",
  "name": "Initial Call",
  "description": "First call to lead",
  "activity_type": "CALL",
  "call_template": "{{template_uuid}}",
  "is_primary": true,
  "display_order": 1,
  "is_active": true
}

request.description: activity_type: CALL/MEETING/EMAIL/FOLLOWUP. is_primary hone pe dusri primary off ho jati hai.
empty body.
lead_id/agent_id/outcome optional filters.
outcome: NO_ANSWER/BUSY/CONNECTED/CALLBACK/COMPLETED/LOST_SUGGESTED. agent khud request user hota hai.
field_key+field_value se data filter hota hai.
data me field_key ki values; call_attempt_id aur quotation_id optional. Submission ke baad trigger rules se task/reminder ban sakti hai.
lead_id ya account_id ya contact_id - koi ek.
template_version_id optional filter.
trigger_condition: ALWAYS/FOLLOW_UP_REQUIRED/OUTCOME_MATCH/FIELD_VALUE_MATCH. assignee_rule: CONDUCTING_AGENT/LEAD_OWNER/SPECIFIC_USER (SPECIFIC_USER pe specific_assignee do).
status: APPROVED / REJECTED. REJECTED pe rejection_reason bhej sakte ho.
submission_id aur field_key optional filters.
